answer_1.quote: We extend MIRACL by generating answers in five languages with a diverse set of LLMs, and collecting judgements on the faithfulness and relevance of the answers... Our focus in this paper is on the text generation performance of RAG systems.

answer_2.quote: Performance is evaluated with Balanced Accuracy (BAcc), with equal weights on each coarse-grained label and language.

answer_3.quote: We run LLM-as-a-judge experiments with various prompting techniques and state-of-the-art LLMs.

answer_4.quote: We employed a professional vendor with native annotators to gather annotations for each sentence of the 250 answers per language... We devised a structured annotation process that achieved a high rate of inter-annotator agreement, guided by a flow‑chart based annotation design.
answer_4.guideline: Flow‑chart based annotation guidelines with coarse‑grained (Supported/Not supported/Challenging) and fine‑grained labels for faithfulness, and Directly answers/Adds context/Unrelated for relevance.
